title: St. Onesiphorus in Scripture
subtitle: Where St. Paul writes of him
source: Scripture is the King James Version, as the app's Bible carries it, word for word. St. Porphyrius, who shares the day, has no public-domain account.

sections.title: 2 Timothy 1:16-18
paragraphs: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me. The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

sections.title: 2 Timothy 4:19
paragraphs: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
